milestone: Make Surface Wake -> Guide Threshold -> Hub Chamber feel like one continuous playable journey before world expansion.
majorSystemRule: No new major system unless existing systems fundamentally cannot produce the desired experience.

interactionFamilyRule.principle: Prefer repeated learnable grammar over one-off interactions.
interactionFamilyRule.minimumUsefulRepetition: A verb/material rule should normally recur enough for recognition before it is significantly varied.

densityRule: Increase relationships and meaning per object/interaction/minute, not simply object count.
tenSecondIdentityTest: A short view should read as a small living Core + Orbiter moving through enormous host matter while physical verbs visibly alter living material.
changeFilter: A proposed HC020 implementation should strengthen at least two design dimensions.

hc020Series.purpose: Map density, attachment, repetition, rhythm, flat spots and regression risks.
Convert Guide Threshold into a distinct material-state interaction family.
Integrate manipulation with movement instead of station-like verb use.
Give Core, Orbiter, Guide and host distinct readable roles and initiative.
Make Hub route identity physically readable before route selection.
Let environmental invitations support route choice without quest-marker dependence.
Tune the complete first journey for repetition, variation, rest, tension and payoff.
Full playthrough and decide whether grammar is ready to propagate to Grave/Vascular/Silt.
